lines: Being hard on yourself doesn't always make you stronger.
Sometimes, it just makes you afraid of making mistakes.
You fail once, and you call yourself a failure.
You make a mistake, and you start doubting your abilities.
You don't have to hate yourself to become a better person.
Research suggests that people can become more motivated to improve when they treat themselves with compassion after a failure.
Take responsibility for your actions, but stop treating every mistake as proof that you are not good enough.
Remember, you can admit that you did something wrong without believing that you are a worthless person.
